{{Otheruses|Nuclear}}
'''Nuclear propulsion''' was a method of space travel that involved constant nuclear fusion reactions to propel a [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] through space. It was extremely primitive compared to [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] and powered warship rockets before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]</ref>
